application_uri.description: Globally unique identifier for the application instance, as of OPC-UA.

machines.description: Connected machines configuration, mapped by machine identifier.

pki_dir.description: Root directory of the OPC-UA PKI.

database.description: ClickHouse database client configuration for archiving traceability data.

opc_ua.description: OPC-UA traceability information model, common to all machines.

queues_not_draining_threshold.description: The upper limit of enqueued part sheets to consider draining as working.

redb_file.description:
Path to the redb file to use for traceability cache. It will be created
if it does not exist.

opc_ua_server.description: OPC-UA server configuration for this machine.

MachineTraceabilityConfig.description: Traceability related configuration for a machine.

line_id.description:
Two character production line identifier, only present if the machine makes
part identifier creation requests.

publish_interval.description: Publish interval for OPC-UA subscription to request variable.

password.description: Password to use if using username/password authentication.

user.description:
Username if authenticating to the OPC-UA server with username/password.
If not provided, anonymous authentication will be used.

TraceabilityCommonOpcUaConfig.description: OPC-UA traceability information model, as implemented by all machines.

general_part_sheet_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the general part sheet object.

heartbeat_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the heartbeat variable.

namespace_url.description: OPC-UA namespace URL used for traceability.

part_id_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the `part ID` variable.

raw_batch_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the raw material batch variable.

raw_part_ref_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the raw part reference variable.

request_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the request variable.

response_nid.description: OPC-UA node identifier of the response variable.

general_part_sheet_table.description: Table to use for general part sheet.

operation_part_sheet_table.description: Table to use for operation part sheet.

part_sheets_drain_period.description: Part sheets draining task execution period.

password_file.description:
Path to a file containing the ClickHouse user's password. Whitespaces around
the password will be removed.

url.description: URL of the ClickHouse HTTP(S) endpoint.
